sheets.prompt:
Create one square contact sheet containing EXACTLY 16 separate child-friendly watercolor illustrations in a strict 4 columns by 4 rows grid. All 16 square cells have equal size and aligned straight boundaries, thin pale gutters. Warm gentle watercolor on clean white or pale cream background, crisp recognizable subjects for a Japanese vocabulary learning app for young children. Keep each subject entirely inside its own cell, centered, with generous 12 percent padding on every edge for cropping. No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no brand names, no labels, no borders around the whole image. Do not merge cells. Each scene is independent. Follow the following order EXACTLY, row-major left to right then top to bottom. 
Row 1 column 1: A friendly full-size city bus, three-quarter view, blue and cream, many passenger windows, no writing.
Row 1 column 2: An empty woven wicker carrying basket with an arched handle.
Row 1 column 3: A roadside bus stop shelter with bench and a round pole sign bearing only a simple bus pictogram.
Row 1 column 4: Two straight wooden Japanese taiko drumsticks lying beside the edge of a taiko drum.
Row 2 column 1: A red soft travel tote bag with two handles and zip, no logo.
Row 2 column 2: A green grasshopper with prominent folded long hind legs on a small leaf.
Row 2 column 3: One wooden baseball bat beside a small white baseball, bat fully visible.
Row 2 column 4: A blooming red rose with green leaves and small visible thorns on its stem.
Row 3 column 1: Two beige adhesive first-aid bandages with central white pads, one crossed over another.
Row 3 column 2: A golden lattice-top baked apple pie on a small plate, with one cut slice showing apple filling.
Row 3 column 3: A whole pineapple with spiky green crown and one yellow cut ring.
Row 3 column 4: A simple silver plumbing pipe elbow joined to a straight hollow pipe section, visible open circular end.
Row 4 column 1: A neatly laid out two-piece blue striped pajama shirt and trousers.
Row 4 column 2: A plate of cooked spaghetti with tomato sauce and a fork at the side.
Row 4 column 3: Fresh curly parsley leaves and stems in a small bunch.
Row 4 column 4: A desktop personal computer with monitor, keyboard and mouse, screen showing simple colorful shapes only.
